severityContext: Latent offline admission contract defects. Every production permission flag was false at the target commit; no actual source was admitted and no production bypass was observed.

records.title: Mandatory archived source evidence could escape rehashing
records.confirmedAtTarget: An optional core evidence pin tree could omit the PEC-1 source capture while preserving its declared SHA in the candidate. Modifying that source capture still returned offline ADMITTED with synthetic authenticated receipts.
records.fix: Rehash all mandatory PEC-1 evidence pins, independently of optional core pins; enforce pin schema.

records.title: Additional required knowledge events accepted unproven references
records.confirmedAtTarget: Other required contract boundaries checked only a timestamp and nonempty reference string; a nonexistent evidence file was sufficient.
records.fix: Require an evidencePin, rehash bytes, resolve the exact pointer and bind its timestamp and reference.

records.title: Inventory alias and whole-report conflicts were not rejected
records.confirmedAtTarget: Inventory membership counted only matching admission IDs; a different candidate/scope could alias that ID. FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS did not conflict with a component statement for the same metric and overlapping period.
records.fix: Require the unique inventory member to equal the reviewed record; treat whole-report/component overlap as conflicting.

records.title: State history was not enforced across admission evaluations
records.confirmedAtTarget: The evaluator recomputed state from current receipts and a revocation snapshot only. Authenticated terminal rejection/revocation or prior restrictions could be lost; stale/missing history was ignored. A caller REVOKED status could also yield validation PASS despite denying use.
records.fix: Require a fresh authenticated history snapshot bound to admission ID and evidence digest; terminal states require new evidence version; prevent restricted-to-unrestricted expansion, require active-event replay and mark revoked validation FAIL.

records.title: INSTANT reporting frame allowed a range spanning a year
records.confirmedAtTarget: The period validator checked date order and an allowed frame enum, but an INSTANT range did not need equal start/end.
records.fix: Require equal period boundaries for INSTANT. No fiscal year assumptions or investment policy changes.

records.title: JSON Pointer accepted negative Python array indices
records.confirmedAtTarget: int(token) accepted -1 as a JSON Pointer array index, permitting a non-RFC pointer alias to the last array entry.
records.fix: Use strict RFC 6901 escapes and canonical nonnegative array index tokens consistently across bundle, mapping and file pin resolution.
